title: Oracle marker update step
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, $f:\bbz\to\mathrm{Option}(\{0,1\})$, $p\in\bbz$, and let $q,q'$ be dispatch states. Choose an input-head position and output word. Suppose the dispatch transition from state $q$, reading the symbols under the heads in the configuration whose first two heads are at $p$ and whose second tape has the bookmark marker at $p$, is exactly the action that leaves the input head stationary, writes the oracle-origin tape content at cell $p$ on tape $1$, leaves that tape's head stationary, makes no other tape changes, emits no output, and enters $q'$. Then one step from this configuration yields the local configuration with state $q'$, first two heads at $p$, and the given input-head position and output.
hypotheses_covered: An input-head position for $x$ is given
The specified transition action equality holds
caveat: The statement concerns private configuration encodings; the transition hypothesis and the resulting configuration are rendered explicitly.
